messages.text: Kicking off the periodic KYC refresh batch for wealth segment low-risk clients. 3-year cycle hits for anyone onboarded in 2023, so that includes {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0187}} (client since Dec 2023). Pipeline queue shows 42 refreshes pending.
Thanks Luis. Reminder KYCPipeline is still under Ops until Oct 6, so flag anything stuck to me. After that it moves to Jenna Cho's team in Compliance Eng.
Quick question: for low-risk individuals, do we need a fresh ID document on refresh or just attestation that nothing's changed?
Per the CDD policy, attestation is fine for low risk unless the ID on file has expired or there's an address change. Then we need new docs in DocVault.
Got it. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0187}}'s ID on file is good through 2028 so attestation only. I'll send the outreach through Jamie Washington since he's the RM.
Heads up, the refresh run re-triggers SanctionsScreen for every client in the batch. Saw some latency on the first 10, roughly 40 sec each vs the usual 5.
Is that SanctionsScreen itself or the pipeline queueing? Compliance owns SanctionsScreen so I'd want Jenna's team to look if it's the screening side.
Looks like the screening side to me. The pipeline hands off instantly and then waits on the response. I'll drop a note in #compliance.

Update: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0187}} refresh flagged because the contact record in ClientHub shows a different {{CLIENT_ADDRESS:c_0187}} than what's in the brokerage account profile. Mismatch between a_00387 and a_00388 records?
Checked. Brokerage ({{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00387}}) has the older address, cash management ({{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00388}}) has the new one. So address change is real and we need proof of address.
Then it's not attestation-only after all. Request a utility bill or bank statement dated within 90 days, upload to DocVault.
Will do. I'll ask Jamie to reach out by phone at {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0187}} since email didn't get a response last cycle.
Can someone give me a status count by end of day? Linda Brandt asked how many refreshes we'll complete before the Oct 6 ownership transition.
Current: 42 in batch, 11 complete, 6 awaiting docs, 25 not started. At this pace we finish the batch by mid-September.
I'd say we'll beat that if SanctionsScreen latency gets fixed. Right now it's the bottleneck.
Update on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0187}}: Jamie reached the client, proof of address coming by email to {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0187}} reply thread tomorrow morning. Marking the case as pending docs.
Great. Please also update the address on a_00387 once verified so the records match. I'll keep the refresh open until then.
Compliance Eng confirmed the SanctionsScreen slowdown was a list reload at 13:30. Latency is back to normal, around 6 sec now.
Good. Luis, rerun the stalled items and I'll update Linda with the count tonight.
